briefings.title: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 Billion
briefings.tldr: AMD is acquiring AI startup World Labs in an $8.2 billion all-stock transaction to integrate its spatial and physical intelligence models with AMD's hardware, software, and systems stack.

briefings.title: IMPERIA: AMD Chair + CEO Dr. Lisa Su on the Future of AI and Leadership
briefings.tldr: AMD Chair and CEO Dr. Lisa Su discussed her career trajectory from an engineer to leading a major semiconductor company, emphasizing the value of running toward difficult problems, maintaining a long-term vision, and embracing ambition.

briefings.title: The Evolution of CPU Architecture in the AI Era: S3 E6

people.name: Mike Clark
people.role: SVP, Corporate Fellow and Chief Architect, AMD

briefings.tldr: AMD CTO Mark Papermaster and Chief Architect Mike Clark trace the six-generation evolution of the Zen CPU architecture—from its 2012 clean-sheet inception to powering modern agentic AI workloads—while detailing the engineering balance of per-core performance, core density, and x86 ecosystem collaboration.

briefings.title: IFA Opening Keynote replay, presented by Jack Huynh

people.name: Jack Huynh
people.role: Senior Vice President and General Manager, AMD

briefings.tldr: AMD opened IFA 2026 by unveiling its "Era of Personal AI" vision, introducing high-performance local AI hardware—including Strix Halo, Gorgon Halo, and the Threadripper Halo Station—designed to run massive frontier-class models locally, maintain user privacy and context, and scale seamlessly from individual developer workstations to enterprise infrastructure.

briefings.title: IFA Opening Keynote, presented by Jack Huynh

people.name: Jack Huynh
people.role: SVP and GM of Computing and Graphics, AMD

briefings.tldr: AMD opening keynote at IFA 2026, presented by Jack Huynh, outlining the transition into the "Era of Personal AI" driven by local device compute, unified memory architectures, agentic workflows, and an open software ecosystem.

briefings.title: Wētā FX on the Future of AI-Powered Storytelling: S3 E5
briefings.tldr: Wētā FX CTO Kimball Thurston and AMD CTO Mark Papermaster explore how AI, heterogeneous computing, and simulation are transforming visual effects for major blockbusters like Avatar 3 and Stranger Things.

briefings.title: From Exascale to Sovereign Intelligence: Powering National AI
briefings.tldr: AI infrastructure has transitioned from a focus on single workloads to an era of heterogeneous compute, where sovereign AI, digital autonomy, and open ecosystems are critical for driving national security, scientific productivity, and economic competitiveness.

briefings.title: Shaping the Future of AI Through Openness: A Fireside Chat with Lisa Su and Clem Delangue
briefings.tldr: AMD Chair and CEO Lisa Su and Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue discussed how open models, accessible local compute, and developer collaboration are accelerating the agentic AI era.

briefings.title: Agentic AI and the Future of Software Development: S3 E4
briefings.tldr: Agentic AI is fundamentally transforming software development and organizational workflows, enabling exponential productivity gains, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous execution.

briefings.title: AMD Advancing AI 2026: Lisa Su Full Keynote
briefings.tldr: AMD CEO Dr. Lisa Su outlined the company's 2026 AI vision at Advancing AI, announcing the production launch of the Helios AI rack, the Venice (Zen 6) server CPU family, and expanding multi-billion-dollar partnerships with OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Cisco, and AT&T.

briefings.title: Advancing AI 2026 | Build What's Next with @AMD
briefings.tldr: AMD announced its 2026 AI roadmap at the Advancing AI event, anchored by the launch of the Helios AI rack, the Venice (6th Gen EPYC) CPU family, the ROCm.ai agentic software platform, and localized hardware like Ryzen AI Halo and Kria robotics modules.

briefings.title: AI Compute: Rebuilt for the Agentic Era | Mark Papermaster, AMD | RAISE Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: AMD is pivoting from a component manufacturer to a holistic systems provider to meet the demands of "Agentic AI," which requires a rebalanced 1:1 ratio of CPUs to GPUs and an open-source ecosystem to ensure enterprise sovereignty and efficiency.

briefings.title: AI at the Edge: S3 E2
briefings.tldr: Liquid AI is pioneering a new class of "Liquid Foundation Models" (LFMs) that are two orders of magnitude smaller than traditional cloud-based models, enabling high-performance, proactive AI agents to run entirely offline on edge devices like AI PCs.

briefings.title: GAEA Talks Live from HumanX - How AMD Plans to Win The AI Era with AMD CTO Mark Papermaster
briefings.tldr: AMD is pursuing a "democratization" strategy for the AI era by building an open ecosystem and modular hardware that spans from massive cloud clusters to local PCs, prioritizing security through confidential computing and energy efficiency to prevent a societal divide between "AI haves and have-nots."
